newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 5.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following business stories on March 5:

WASHINGTON - The U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission and Mitsubishi Motor Manufacturing of America Inc. are locked in a legal battle over the government's ability to advise women who may become plaintiffs in the agency's biggest sexual harassment suit ever.
WASHINGTON - Analysts see health care costs increasing by three to five percent this year with larger jumps in 1998.
WASHINGTON - America Online Inc. opened its "chat rooms" to advertisers in a step to remake itself in the image of advertising-supported media companies.
WASHINGTON - A government report showed that planes are getting more crowded and airlines are making more money, but fares are low as well.
TOKYO - Top financial officials of the six leading Asia-Pacific economic powers met to lay a framework for tackling financial problems that are roiling the world's fastest-growing region.
